author: Kate Chopin
title: The Awakening
edition: Wikisource transcription (Index: The Awakening - Kate Chopin.djvu) of Chicago and New York: Herbert S. Stone & Company, 1899 (copyright 1899), identified by its transcribed title and copyright leaves. Every selected word was collated against OCR of the dated 1899 first-edition scan (Internet Archive awakeningthe00choprich), with the University of Virginia 'Literature in Context' transcription as a second witness; 35 Wikisource word errors in the selected chapters were corrected to the scan's readings (several confirmed visually); the missing comma in 'Why, it seems' (Chapter XXXIX) was restored and a stray comma left in Chapter XXXIII ('that is, , it') removed, both from the scan. HTML presentation removed and whitespace normalized; chapter numerals separate consecutive chapters. The library holds the whole novel, Chapters I–XXXIX, under its title. The collation and corrections above cover the chapters used as nightly readings; elsewhere the Wikisource transcription is reproduced as transcribed.

rights.basis: Original English novel published in 1899 by Herbert S. Stone & Company, before 1931; its US term has expired as of 2026. The dated scan is marked NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.

Removed the Wikisource header, page-number anchors, licence and other no-export elements and the ornamental rule; each HTML paragraph, and each run of text set directly in a section, became a paragraph with whitespace (including no-break spaces) collapsed to single spaces; italics dropped to plain text; the book title became a level-1 heading and the centred chapter numerals level-2 headings. The 36 word- and punctuation-level corrections that the nightly selections carry from the collation declared in the edition were applied at the same places.
